main_text.p: illa afficerent, divinare licet, non de-monstrare ; hoc disci non potest, nisi ex Grammatica, aut ex ipsorum Samarita-norum pronuntiantium auditu. Ego sic pronunciarem Bescham Ab ubar veri-ach quadesch, quod ad virgulas, quas dictionum quibusdam literis imminentes animadvertisti, multo frequentiores sunt in nostro codice, qvàm in tuo; usu autem didici, illis significare, verbum in u-sitatiori significatione esse sumendum, vel verbum passivè intelligendum, vel contra formam scribi vel quid simile.

De Hebraicarum dictionum pronunci-atione plane tibi assentior, multisqve ar-gumentis demonstrare possem antiqvis-simos Judæos multa aliter pronuntiasse, qvam jubeant Masorethicæ censuræ, ut ineptissimas lectionis eorum argutiolas præterea.
Cum desideres Sectionum, capitum & versuum tuo codici adnota-tionem, hoc sedulò & terse inter legen-dum præstabo.
Qvæ de Persici imperii Historica & Politica Geographia scripsi-sti, sive literis ad amicos, sive libri, in hanc

page.notes: The Hebrew is printed in Latin letters (transliteration), in italics, so it is copied as printed. A small mark "]" stands after "dictionum" in the line "dictionum quibusdam"; it looks like a printing blemish and is not transcribed. The right side of the scan is a dark strip of the neighbouring page and is not transcribed. No marginal notes on this page.
